tours.description:
Jump into Kauai's Ultimate WEST SIDE Whale & Dolphin Zodiac Boat Adventure – Your Portal to the Ocean's Grand Spectacles!

Available Seasonally: November/December – March/April Each Year.

Discover Nature's Majesty from Kauai’s West Side

Embark on an exhilarating Whale & Dolphin Zodiac Boat Adventure from Kekaha, the gateway to unparalleled marine experiences. From late November/early December to March, the western waters of Kauai transform into a vibrant stage for the North Pacific Humpback whales, the majestic "gentle giants" of the sea.

The Advantage of Kekaha’s West Side

Kekaha’s prime location on Kauai's west side offers swift access to the most dynamic whale habitats, ensuring more frequent sightings and an extraordinary adventure amidst the ocean's wonders.

A Journey with the Ocean's Titans

Marvel at the elegance of these colossal beings as they undertake their 3,000-mile migration to Hawaiian waters, a spectacle of nature's grandeur and a testament to the resilience of life.

Whale Watching, Not Whale Seeing: A Celebration of Nature’s Unpredictability

Our WEST SIDE Whale Watchin

Begin Your Luau Kalamaku Experience with a True Taste of Kauai Whether it’s an intimate party of two or a celebration for up to 20, enjoy a specialized dinner at Gaylord’s Restaurant at Kilohana.

This tour provides a laid-back, leisurely vibe as you cruise along the coastline, with plenty of opportunities to capture photos, enjoy snorkeling*, and learn about the island's fascinating history.

tours.description:
Full-Day Kauaʻi Adventure
About

This is our most popular tour. We often combine sightseeing and hiking because the drive time to some trail heads is quite far from most of the resort areas. The Na Pali Coast, Na Pali Cliff Tops, Waimea Canyon (both floor and rim), Alakai Swamp, Interior Mountains, Beach and Coastal Hikes, and many Kauai Waterfalls, as well as some of our Specialty Tours. These tours can vary in difficulty from easy to strenuous with trails ranging from wide and well-maintained to some of the moderate off-trail hikes. Choosing a full day tour allows you the time to really experience the majestic serenity of Kauai from ridge tops high above the coast, to cascading waterfalls, Kauai Hiking Adventures has something for everyone.

tours.name: Private North Shore and Waterfalls Tour
tours.description:
Experience the beautiful North Shore of Kauai. Our first stop is the Wailua falls, with a 173' drop. In the distance we see Mt. Waialeale, the wettest spot on Earth!
Heading north we'll stop at the Opaeka'a waterfall and enjoy a majestic view overlooking the Wailua river valley.
The next stop is your choice of either the Kauai Hindu Monastery or Smith's Hawaii, a tropical botanical garden with lots of peacocks and other birds you can feed. Great picture taking!
On our way north we travel through the town of Kapaa where we see 100 year old coconut trees. Learn about the legends of Kalalea Mountain and the secrets that it hides. Next stop is the Kilauea Lighthouse with incredible views and a multitude of birds gliding overhead.
We head to Hanalei town for lunch and shopping. Then we take a walk out on Hanalei pier for spectacular views of Mt. Namolokama and the beautiful Hanalei Bay.

Water, drinks and snacks are included

no-host lunch

tours.name: Private Lesson
tours.description:
Learn to Surf

If you are vacationing in Hawai'i, one of the greatest experiences you can have is to surf. The first time you catch a wave is a thrill you will keep for the rest of your life. Charlie Smith is a professional surfer and an elite surfing coach who has been giving vacationers that thrill since the 90s.

How does it work?

The most important thing about surfing is the proper way to stand on the surfboard. Charlie first teaches his surf students this skill with the surfboards safely laid out on the beach. Then it's time to put that lesson to practice in the surf. Charlie will guide the small group of students to where the waves break, let you know when to paddle, catch the wave, and stand up to ride the wave.

We provide surf boots and shirts, soft-top surfboards and leash; all you have to do is surf and have fun! We like to keep the class sizes small, usually between 4 and 6 people. If you have a larger group, please contact us ahead of time (preferably before you arrive on Kaua'i) so we can make arrangements for everyone to learn to surf in a safe environment. Paula Fuga

Exquisite vocals, powerful lyrics and gorgeous melodies make Paula Fuga one of the most sought-after live performers in Hawai‘i. A poet and accomplished ‘ukulele player, her songs embody a personal style that combines storytelling with passion and intense emotion that endears her to audiences around the world. Blending sweet island vibes, R&B, and Jawaiian roots reggae in the mix, she has been called Queen of Hawaiian Soul. Championed by Jack Johnson who signed her to his record label, she has been honored with Hawai’i’s coveted “Female Vocalist of the Year” Award. She returns to Kaua'i with her stellar band to share her vocal gifts and her favorite holiday tunes. Celebrate the season with Paula Fuga as she comes “Home for the Holidays"!

The Vitals 808

The Vitals 808: Oahu’s Reggae Powerhouse

Hailing from the lush Windward side of Oahu, The Vitals have been electrifying Hawaii’s music scene since 2013. With a lineup that fuses raw talent and aloha spirit, the band features founding members Keahi Pi'iohia (vocals/keys), Cyd Rosa (vocals), Ata Boy Rosa (vocals/guitar), and Brandon Berinobis, alongside Asaiah "the Maad King" Scott (vocals/guitar), Guy Heresa (bass), and Lapana Ieriko (drums). Former band members include Nainoa Heffernan (vocals), Kainoa Ah Chong (drums), Shay Marcello (bass), Darin Garcia (guitar), and Tony Vierra-Albao (guitar).

Hit Makers with a Heartbeat

The Vitals burst onto the scene with their debut EP in 2014, igniting airwaves with the reggae anthem "Fake Lover." They didn’t stop there—follow-ups like their full-length album and 2019 EP featured epic collaborations with Hawaii’s reggae heavyweights, including Lion Fiyah, Bo Napoleon, Mahkess, and Kanakamon of Kapu System. Their music isn’t just catchy; it’s a bridge between culture and creativity, striking a chord with fans island-wide.

tours.description:
Poolside

with special guest lovetempo

Show Date

Thursday March 27, 2025

Poolside

Poolside is the recording project of producer, songwriter and multi- instrumentalist Jeffrey Hawaii. In 2011 Poolside set out to produce appropriately chill music for summer soirees, a light but danceable kind of music with sunny vibes and liquid rhythm that Hawaii dubbed “Daytime Disco.” Since then, Poolside has released four acclaimed albums – Pacific Standard Time (2012), Heat (2017), Low Season (2020) and this year’s Blame It All On Love (2023) – remixed countless high-profile acts such as Billy Idol, Jack Johnson & Milky Chance, DRAMA, Miami Horror, L’impératrice, Purple Disco Machine, Big Wild, Zoe and more. Poolside has also recently collaborated with Todd Edwards, NEIL FRANCES, Brijean, Foster The People and Buscabulla.

Poolside’s fourth studio album ‘Blame It All On Love’ finds singer, songwriter, producer, multi-instrumentalist and visionary Jeffrey Hawaii leaving the shallows and entering the depths of his own creative voice. Its 11 tracks are funky, soulful, laidback and full of hooks that elevate Poolside’s sound to poignant pop heights.

tours.name: Mahalo Dead
tours.description:
Mahalo Dead featuring Bill Kreutzmann of the Grateful Dead

TICKETS ON SALE 10 A.M. HAWAIIAN TIME OCTOBER 18

Join us for a three-day celebration of live music with Mahalo Dead, featuring legendary Grateful Dead drummer Bill Kreutzmann! This event will take place at Kauai's premier live music venue, The Porter Pavilion located at Anaina Hou Community Park.

Mahalo Dead brings the spirit of the Grateful Dead to life, with Kreutzmann leading an incredible lineup of talented musicians, creating a musical journey through improvisation, timeless classics, and the vibrant sounds of Hawaii.

Mahalo Dead will feature Bill Kreutzmann alongside Jason Hann, Daniel Donato, Jake Brownstein, Adam MacDougall, and Reed Mathis.

These shows aren’t just about the music—they are a fundraiser to support The Porter Pavilion, Bill Kreutzmann's home venue here on Kauai. Proceeds will go towards the continued development and preservation of this beloved community hub, ensuring it remains a space where music, art, and culture can thrive.

Don't miss your chance to be part of this unique event—three nights of magical music under the Hawaiian stars, all while supporting a cause close to Bill's heart.

These are the only live performances from Bill Kreutzmann worldwide in 2024!

tours.name: 8 Hour PRIVATE Kauai Sportfishing Tour
tours.description:
Our PRIVATE tour, is just that. We close the boat to other groups and keep it to just your group! Get your group together and reserve the boat today!
Important Information
Our fishing vessel the "Pi'ikea' can take a maximum of 6 people.
Once on board we'll give a short safety briefing and get on our way. Time for the tour starts once we leave the dock.
About

Typically we'll begin setting the lines in the water as we are exiting the outer break wall and officially declare the fishing has started!

We'll look at the weather, rely on chatter from other captains and make notes of where we were catching fish the days before to help determine our path for your tour. Based on the length of the trip and time of year we may not be more than one mile or two offshore or we may get 12-15 miles.

80%-90% of what we do will be trolling with artificial lures. On occasion we use dead bait and chunk bait and do a surface jig at the buoys. (When we live bait, the bait is to be caught first thing in the morning).

What's Included

Learn about underwater navigation, deep diving and three types of specialty diving that interest you. After some skill practice with your instructor, you'll make five open water dives. There's no exam because this course is truly about having fun and gaining experience.

Advanced Open Water Diver eLearning includes interactive lessons on 13 popular specialty dives: altitude, boat, digital underwater imaging, drift, dry suit, fish ID, night, buoyancy, search and recovery, underwater naturalist and wreck diving.

You'll study deep and navigation diving plus three specialties of your choosing.

The course includes five dives: a deep dive below 18m/60f, a navigation dive, and three specialty dives. Gain experience, build confidence and discover your diving abilities.

tours.name: The Bird Tour
tours.description:
This seasonal walking tour features areas of habitat that some of Kauai‘s native birds call home. Na ‘Āina Kai is one of the few places in the Hawaiian Islands where one can view albatross nests. The timing of these tours is set to allow visitors to observe some of the extraordinary activities of Laysan Albatross during nesting season which can include their unique mating/courtship dances, nest building, and/or chick care. The Garden is also home to two critically endangered species, the Hawaiian goose (nene) and the Hawaiian moorhen, both of which nest here. Other birds you may see are red-footed boobies, tropicbirds, great frigate birds, and pacific golden-plover. This special tour visits areas of Na ‘Āina Kai that other tours do not include. A 48-hour notice is required for tour cancellations or reservation changes. Closed-toe shoes are recommended.
Must be age 13 or older.

This tour is limited to 6 guests per guide.

tours.name: From Ma'alaea Harbor: Maui Whale Watch Cruise
tours.description:
Experience the awe-inspiring behaviors of the Humpback whales on this incredible whale watching adventure

Come aboard a power catamaran with two decks, each providing excellent vantage points for viewing the Humpback whales. Whether you are seated outside on the upper deck or inside the shaded cabin, all feel like front row seats. Our Captain will provide an expert narrative of the Humpback whale's historical significance in Maui waters and "play-play" commentary of the incredible whale behaviors as you view them.

Have your cameras ready to capture these majestic creatures blowing huge sprays into the air, slapping their fins and tails, spy hopping, and the awe-inspiring breach. This is when a whale the size of a school bus launches its body clear out of the water and crashes down, creating huge splashes that can be seen from great distances. You can even listen to the magical whale songs when our crew lowers the hydrophone, an underwater microphone into the water below.

Expert narration on whale behaviors

Our experienced guides are knowledgeable, approachable, and happy to answer questions about whale behavior, migration, and what you’re seeing on the water.

We return to the harbor just after sunset, often with golden light, calm seas, and a few final whale sightings to end the evening.

Every lesson is private for you and your ohana. Taught by friendly and experienced instructors, you’ll get the personalized attention you need to succeed at catching some waves.

All lessons start on land with safety and technique instruction before heading into the ocean to put your new skills into action for catching your first waves! At all times you’ll be close to one of our incredible surf instructors.

tours.description:
Maui's Most Incredible Snorkeling
Trip Details
5 Hours – 7:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.
Departing daily

Occasionally Molokini weather can be a bit unpredictable. If that’s the case, we’ll sail to a snorkel destination that is safe and more suitable to conditions.

About

Molokini is one of Maui’s most incredible snorkeling destinations. The unique, crescent shaped crater is a natural marine preserve, and is home to over 250 species of tropical fish. Sail Maui combines the elements of performance sailing in the trade winds with snorkeling in the protected, crystal clear water at Molokini crater for a truly outstanding experience.

Discover Molokini aboard Akialoa, where your trip includes a continental breakfast on the leisurely sail across Mā’alaea Bay. Take in the landscape that makes Maui special, and during whale season (December – May), spot the humpback whales as they swim nearby. While at Molokini, swim, snorkel, and rinse off with our fresh water shower. After snorkeling, we’ll invite you to indulge in a freshly prepared lunch and refresh with a variety of beverages, including wine and local beer.

tours.name: Ohana Seating
tours.description:
The Wailele Lū‘au invites you to experience Hawaiian culture through mesmerizing ‘oli (chanting), hula (dancing), and traditional island-style cuisine on the Kā‘anapali Coast. As the sun sets over the ‘Au‘au Channel, watch legends of gods, goddesses, and heroes like Maui come alive, revealing the rich history and interconnectedness of the Hawaiian people, land, and ocean.

Guests will also witness Maui’s most spectacular fire knife performance, an exhilarating and highlight of the evening.

What's included

This family-friendly evening features a delicious buffet, unlimited drinks, and a fire knife dance finale, offering visitors an journey into the heart of Hawai‘i. Your ticket price includes unlimited trips to the buffet and bar, so we encourage guests to arrive with an appetite.

A children’s buffet is available for the keiki joining us, with options like onigiri (Japanese rice ball), macaroni and cheese, french fries, chicken karaage, and more. And just for adults, a full bar with unlimited beer, wine, and island cocktails is included in your ticket price.

WEST MAUI ADVENTURE
Circumnavigate the West Maui Volcano clockwise starting in Kahului through Lahaina and around the steep scenic cliffs and rugged mauka terrain.
This adventure begins with a visit to some ancient petroglyphs just south of Lahaina. We will then pass through Lahaina town, which was the centerpiece of the Hawaiian Kingdom and later the whaling capitol of the world.
Headed north-west around the mountain is a perfect picture taking opportunity at the overlook for Honolua Bay one of the very few Marine Sanctuary’s on Maui. As we drive along the cliffs there will be opportunities to stop to see the blow-hole and other interesting sights.
As we continue around, we enter a beautiful Hawaiian village, one of the last truly subsistence communities on Maui and look into the ancient Hawaiian political structure an ahupuaa, enjoy visiting various local artist galleries the most exhilarating ocean tide pool spots.

AS THE PIONEER OF THE DOWNHILL BIKE RIDES, WE OFFER THE FREEDOM OF UNGUIDED WITH THE RELIABILITY OF GUIDED.
Please note we do not currently do pickups or go into National Parks.
Duration

3 hours

About

Your adventure begins at the MMC Cabana at 497 Baldwin avenue where you will meet with your driver. There, you will review safety guidelines, sign liability forms, and get your gear. Bikes and helmets are fitted and handed out when you reach the starting point.

On your way up, your driver will immerse you in the rich history, customs, and culture of our beloved Maui and Haleakala. Your driver will explain to you the towns, restaurants, and shopping that is available to you. When you reach approximately 6500 ft, you will receive your bike and helmet, and your adventure begins!

Please keep in mind that these bikes do not have gears - they are designed for downhill riding only.

Journey Overview
You will start your adventure at the Haleakala Ranch. From there, you will go through the fabulous 29 turn "switchbacks".
You will also get a peek at the islands of Lanai, Kahoolawe, and Molokini. After coming out of the switchbacks, Kula has fragrant smells of eucalyptus, ginger, and lavender and the native flower Ohia.
Once you have worked up an appetite, there is a great eatery in Kula you
highlights: You will start your adventure at the Haleakala Ranch. From there, you will go through the fabulous 29 turn "switchbacks".
Once you have worked up an appetite, there is a great eatery in Kula you may visit called The Kula Lounge, which can help fuel you for the remainder of the ride down.
From Kula, you will ride into the town of Makawao. There are shops, eateries, and the infamous Komoda Store known best for their delicious donuts.
As you continue your journey through Makawao you will come to the old churches, follow through to Paia and the Old Sugar Mill.
Your journey will end back at the base yard. Meet back up with your driver, drop off your bike, buy a t-shirt, and enjoy the rest of your stay on Maui.

tours.name: Haleakalā Walking Tour
tours.description:
Haleakalā Walking Tour Highlights

On this Haleakalā walking tour, you will embark on an adventure to reach the summit of the magnificent Haleakalā volcano, standing tall at 10,023ft. As you ascend, you will encounter panoramic views that are sure to take your breath away. Your expert guide will accompany you every step of the way and provide valuable insight into the geological and cultural significance of this incredible natural wonder.

You will also have the opportunity to walk to all the scenic lookouts, where you can witness the awe-inspiring beauty of Maui's landscapes. This small group adventure has a maximum capacity of 10 passengers, ensuring a personalized and intimate experience.

Throughout the tour, you will be treated to views of Maui's unique geography, including its sprawling coastline, lush forests, and volcanic craters. Your expert guide will provide fascinating information about the history, ecology, and geology of the region, enriching your experience and deepening your appreciation of the natural world.

You'll also enjoy a delicious lunch and snacks, included in the tour, to keep you energized for the journey. So come along, and let us take you on an walking tour of Haleakalā National Park!

tours.name: Classic Whale Watch
tours.description:
Each year the Pacific Humpback Whales migrate from Alaska to the coastal waters off Maui.

Join our experts aboard our luxury catamarans for West Maui’s favorite Whale Watch tour, directly from the world famous Ka’anapali Beach on Maui. Multiple departures daily, 7:30a, and 10a. Convenient beach loading eliminates the hassle of driving to a state harbor, allowing guests the unique experience of boarding a luxury catamaran directly from the beach. Our whale watching tours include snacks, beverages and an open bar. You will sail on one of our state-of-the-art, spacious catamarans with a marine naturalist on board to educate and inform you about the North Pacific Humpback Whales that migrate to Maui each year. You will also listen to the whale songs live on our underwater hydrophone and witness these majestic creatures and learn more about them in their natural habitat. Reserve your adventure today!

tours.name: Halfway to Hana + Waterfall & Garden of Eden Tour
tours.description:
Halfway to Hana + Garden of Eden Tour
Itinerary:

Welcome aboard our guided tour as we embark on a thrilling journey along the winding road to Hana, one of the most scenic routes in all of Hawaii. Our itinerary for the day includes:

Departure from Kahului 8AM (checkin at 745AM): Our van is equipped with all the necessary safety features, and our experienced driver will make sure your ride is smooth and safe along the winding Road to Hana.

Ke'anae Peninsula: First we'll head to the Ke'anae Peninsula, a small village that offers a glimpse into old Hawaii. We'll stop at the iconic Ke'anae Peninsula Church, a picturesque church that has stood for over a century. You'll have the chance to admire the architecture of this historic church, which is surrounded by lush greenery and overlooks the blue waters of the Pacific Ocean.

Our exciting itinerary includes a delightful stop at a magnificent waterfall, where we can all take a dip and have a splashing good time. You'll have the chance to swim in the crystal-clear waters and embrace the beauty of nature.

Garden of Eden: With our guided tour, you can skip the long lines at The Garden of Eden and enter through a private entrance, complete with convenient private parking. This exclusive access ensures that you have more time to explore the beautif
highlights: Safe and reliable transportation to ensure a smooth ride along the winding road.
Lunch and snacks to keep you fueled and energized throughout the trip.
Ample water and other beverages to keep you well-hydrated during the journey.
An unforgettable experience that promises to be both enjoyable and fun.

tours.name: Sunset Whale Watch and 1 Tank Night Dive
tours.description:
Yes, you CAN have the best of both worlds! Check in at 4:PM for your sunset whale watch and follow it up with a 1 tank night dive!
Times

1 Hour Before Sunset, varies seasonally

About

Certified divers will enjoy this trip. Night Dives are suitable for experienced divers as well as novices and our crew does their best to group divers according to experience level with the goal of providing the best trip for each type of customer! IMPORTANT NOTE: If it has been over two years since your last dive, Maui Diamond require that you complete a Refresher Dive prior to your boat trip or hire a Private Dive Guide for your dives.

What to Expect:

We'll meet at the boat and 4:00 and head out for a couple of hours of whale watching until the sun goes down. After that, we'll tuck in along the Pali to an area of the coastline that is sheltered from the wind. All the cool critters come out at night right after the fish go to bed, so divers can expect to see invertebrates such as nudibranches, lobsters, octopus and squids.

Divers must provide their own lights

DIVER MEDICAL FORM REQUIRED: All certified divers are required to complete a medical history form and some will be required to obtain their physician's release to participate in scuba diving. Here's a link to the form for easy reference and in case it's needed for a doctor visit.

tours.name: Premier Whale Watch *Private Charter* 3 HOURS + SNORKEL
tours.description:
Personalized Experience with Maui's Whales

Experience Maui’s humpback whales on a fully private whale watch designed to give you the best memories for you and your friends and family. Aboard our fast, stable rigid-hulled raft, you’ll enjoy close-to-the-water viewing, expert interpretation of whale behavior, and the freedom to move, photograph, and observe without sharing space with other guests.
Enjoy additional time on the water observing the whales, OR jump in at one of Maui's premier snorkel sites to explore our underwater habitat and HEAR the whalesong as you float in the water.

Every tour is different. You may encounter mothers and calves, competitive pods, breaching whales, or hear haunting whale songs through our onboard hydrophone. Your experienced captain customizes each outing based on ocean conditions, whale activity, and your interests—whether you’re seeking a peaceful morning on calm seas or a more adventurous afternoon ride. Drive to Pu’u’ula’ula where we explore the summit (15-minute walk) and examine the highly endangered, endemic Silversword plant
Gaze at the horizon, revealing the outer lying islands of Lana’i, Kaho’olawe and Hawai’i (Big Island)
Perch for sunset high above the coast and clouds
Return to our starting point

Snorkel gear (mask, fins, wetsuit)

tours.name: Whale Watch Adventure
tours.description:
Come join us for yet another spectacular adventure.

From December to April, the Humpback Whales come to give birth, breed and nurse their young.

Our tour offers you a rare opportunity to view, listen (we have hydrophones on board) and experience Humpback Whales. The Kona Ocean Adventures team will astound you with little-known facts local knowledge about these gentle giants as they play, court and teach their young….the longest known migration of any mammal…

The Humpback whales seen here are returning from their feeding grounds in Southeastern Alaska. They come here not to escape the cold but to give birth to their young. The reason is when a calf is born, it has no blubber insulation to keep it warm in the cold waters of Alaska. They seek out breeding waters here which offer temperatures of approximately 75 degrees.

What's included

2.5 hour whale watching adventure

tours.name: Maunakea Stellar Explorer Hilo
tours.description:
For an out-of-this-world experience, check out Maunakea Stellar Explorer from KapohoKine Adventures.
Duration

7 Hours

About

For an out-of-this-world experience, check out Maunakea Stellar Explorer from KapohoKine Adventures. This thrilling adventure is the only Big Island star tour to feature nighttime astronomical observing AND safe daytime solar viewing with all ages welcome! Our in-house stellar explorers are the best and most experienced in Hawaii with one having created the Mauna Kea Visitor’s Center and operated it for a decade. Others on staff have written noted articles and reviews for well-known astronomy magazines and have worked at observatories. Start your adventure in quaint Hilo town where you’ll drive along the historic waterfront before arriving at Rainbow Falls. This iconic waterfall right off a postcard features an 80 foot tall twin waterfall system. Look for the rainbow effect that gives the waterfall its name! Continue traveling up the Wailuku River to Boiling Pots. Impressive photo opportunities are often found here when the river “boils” through depressions in the rocks. Explore Kaumana Caves, part of the lava tube system that brought lava 1.5 miles from Hilo-town in 1881.

tours.name: Kona Haunted Hele 👻
tours.description:
Our most popular tour!
Duration

2 Hours

TOUR OVERVIEW:
Step into the spooky past and supernatural happenings of Kailua-Kona on this evening tour. After the sun dips down, follow an expert local guide as you explore eerie tales of hauntings and real-life historical events that are sure to send chills down your spine.

​Meet up with your guide and set out on foot down the historic Ali'i Drive beginning the tour with a prayer of protection, a statement of intention, and a brief overview of Kona's fascinating, mystery-filled history. From there, make your way to various locations where supernatural events are believed to have occurred, from the historic location of human sacrifices to the path where the ghostly, torch-wielding Night Marchers are believed to walk.

Pass by the one-time royal summer palace of Hawaii's kings and queens, see the first Christian church in the islands, and roam among the tombstones in 2 cemeteries. Hear about the history of the old Kona Inn, built on the site of an ancient temple known to have more than 40 totem-style ki'i statues. At each location, put specialized paranormal activity detection equipment to the test as you try to seek out the energy of spiritual beings, and wrap up your haunted foray with a cleansing white sage smudge.

Experience the thrill of deep sea fishing off the coast of Hilo on a private big game fishing charter. What to Expect:
You’re standing on what feels like the top of the world as a surreal landscape engulfs you. Here, at the top of the Kilauea volcano, a patchwork of jagged rocks, boulders, and craggy outcroppings are the result of ancient volcanic eruptions. Renowned scientists and scholars have stood in your footsteps before, studying this active volcano said to be governed by the Hawaiian Goddess of fire, Pele. It is a humbling experience that fills you with a deep sense of respect for the power and unpredictability of nature. This is the heart of Hawaiʻi — its volcanoes — and you are feeling its pulse in the company of your small group of friends or family for a memory that will last a lifetime.

About

The Pelagic Night Dive is a 1-tank black water dive off of the Kona coast. We start our Pelagic Night Dive 2-3 miles off the Kona coat. Then, floating tethered offshore in the deep dark sea, we wait to see what goes by, usually staying around 50 feet in depth. Our lights attract microscopic zooplankton like moths to a porch light, which in turn draws in miniature open ocean predators like jellyfish and squid. Hang suspended in the blackness of the Pacific Ocean as you experience what only a few ever dream of seeing. The Pelagic Night Dive, an experience of a lifetime!

Kailua-Kona is one of the only places in the world where you can snorkel with manta rays at night—a rare and experience.

Guests will swim approximately 50 feet from the boat to our paddleboard-based lighting system, which acts as a gathering point for the manta rays. Manta Magic is a nighttime snorkeling experience off Kona that brings you face to face with graceful manta rays attracted to plankton around illuminated boards. Led by a swim guide, guests float at the surface and watch the manta rays swoop and feed in a spectacular, close-up ballet beneath the stars. The operator is Green Listed by the Manta Ray Advocates of Hawaii and provides equipment and nonalcoholic beverages to make this marine encounter safe and comfortable.

Wetsuit top (optional)

Nonalcoholic beverages

Arrive at the manta ray site and receive a briefing from your swim guide.
Enter the water and hold onto a light board that attracts plankton and manta rays.
Float at the surface and watch manta rays feed and glide beneath you for up to 40 minutes.
Return to the boat and cruise back to harbor under the stars.

tours.name: Private Extended Day Rock Climbing
tours.description:
Join our team of professional guides for a guided rock climbing experience like no other. Descend alongside cascading waterfalls in collapsed lava tube canyons surrounded by lush jungle scenery before climbing back out. Closer to the Japanese practice of Sawanobori than the standard rock climbing found in much of the world, this is a unique climbing experience only found in Hawaii.

Due to generally poor rock quality on the island, there is very little climbing available on the Big Island of Hawaii. After 4 years of research, development, and private landowner negotiations, we are excited to finally be able to offer the Island’s first rock climbing experience. This adventure takes you to an area with some of the best rock quality on the island, exclusively accessible to the general public through these tours.

We offer Private extended day trips (6hrs) and half-day trips (3hrs) at a 3-to-1 client-to-guide ratio.

Climb on volcanic rock with panoramic river, waterfall, and rainforest views.

Expert local guides ensure a safe, fun, and personalized adventure.

tours.name: Lei Po'o Making Workshop (Flowered Head Lei) Saturday, January 10th
tours.description:
Learn the sacred art of lei po'o making by harvesting ferns and flowers from the forest to weave and design your very own lei po'o (Hawai'ian flower and plant crown)!
You’ll leave adorned with your handmade lei poʻo to wear during your time in Hawai‘i, perfect for photos in the forest or at the beach, while forming a deeper connection with traditional Hawai'ian practices and the 'āina (land).

Saturday, January 10th | 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM Temple Space | Kona Cloud Forest Sanctuary

Join us for a heart-centered morning in the cloud forest, guided by our special guest Kiana with Kiki and Naia Hawai'i, in the sacred Hawaiian art of lei poʻo making, the traditional Hawai'ian craft of weaving a flower and plant crown for the head.

Together, we’ll begin by connecting with the land, mindfully harvesting ferns, flowers, and natural elements from the forest using respectful gathering practices. Surrounded by the sounds and scents of the forest, you’ll learn to weave and design your very own lei poʻo, reflecting a unique expression of the beauty of nature and your connection to it.

As you craft, Kiana will share the deeper Hawaiian wisdom behind this sacred ritual,

tours.name: Kona In-Shore Fishing
tours.description:
Join Kona Shore Divers for an inshore fishing adventure off the Kona coast! Departing from Kailua Pier, this 2- to 3-hour trip is perfect for families, first-time anglers, or anyone looking to experience the thrill of fishing Kona’s calm, fish-rich nearshore waters. Target local favorites like papio (trevally), roi, and other reef species using light tackle while enjoying views of Hualālai and the Kona coastline. With expert local guides, top-quality gear, and a focus on fun and sustainability, it’s the ideal way to fish Hawaii without heading far offshore.

What's included

Premium rods, reels, and light tackle—perfect for reeling in papio, uku, and other Kona reef fighters

Fresh bait and custom lures tailored for local waters

Friendly, experienced local guide who knows every Kona hotspot

Iced cooler stocked for your drinks

Chilled bottled water to keep you refreshed

Epic coastal views of lava cliffs, sea caves, and marine life—often with dolphin or manta ray sightings

Cancellations

tours.name: Private Sunset Catamaran Cruise & Swim Keanuenue
tours.description:
Discover the beautiful views of the ocean, local wildlife, the iconic east side of Oahu, and the sun dipping into the sea as you join us on a private catamaran cruise in Waikiki. We’ll depart from Kewalo Basin Harbor located in Honolulu and make our way up the coastline to Diamond Head, making stops along the way for any turtles, dolphins, or whales we may spot during our journey.

Once at the top of our route, we will find a calm anchorage to relax at and enjoy the Hawaii sunset. Guests are welcome to join me for guided snorkeling and swimming or just dip their toes in the water as we soak in the beautiful afternoon. Lastly, we will watch the sunset in the ocean as we head back to the harbor.

The vessel is exclusively reserved for your party so you are welcome to play your own music and bring any refreshments you would like to enjoy during our time together. I’ll happily be sharing my local knowledge and the cultural history of the area we are traveling in throughout the cruise. There is no better way to end the day!

What's included

tours.name: Dolphin Excursion
tours.description:
View Wild Dolphins all year round and Humpback Whales during the winter months!
Times and Duration
Daily, 7:00 AM and 10:30 AM
3 hours
About
Want to swim with dolphins? This tour provides the best opportunity to see wild dolphins underwater!
View Wild Dolphins in their natural environment. Bottlenose, Spotted, Spinners and other larger dolphins are frequently found.
Humpback Whales are spotted during the winter months from mid December to the end of March.
Dolphin sightings are guaranteed on these morning tours with a return trip voucher if we can not find them.
Avoid crowds! Only 16 guests maximum on a tour.
All tours are guided by lifeguard certified marine biologists and naturalists.
Snorkel with Sea Turtles and Tropical Fish at nearby reefs.
Take amazing photographs and video. You may bring any type of camera you would like or you can rent one of our Go Pros. You keep the SD card!
Snacks and beverages are welcome for you to bring

tours.name: Next|Level Oahu Circle Island Tour
tours.company: If Can, Can. LLC - Oahu Best Tours
tours.description:
Let us take you on an amazing journey around the island of Oahu! Local Hawaiian guided tour. Fully narrated with over 16 locations. Experience the most epic Oahu circle island tour and adventure in Hawaii.
Times and duration
Pickup Starts at 6:45am
Return approximately at 5:30pm
About

We will hit every spot on the way that just can’t be missed. Our local tour guide will narrate the tour about the Hawaiian history, cultural folklores and legends as we traverse around the island. We will stop by multiple top attractions, watch a volcanic blowhole explode like a geyser, enjoy some complimentary Mac nut samples and Kona coffee at a tropical farm, eat at a local shrimp stand, indulge on some ice cold coconuts, snorkel with turtles at the popular Turtle beach on the North Shore and explore the picturesque temple of Byodo-In.
Enjoy some pineapple ice cream at Dole Plantation toward the end of the journey. It will be an amazing fun day FULL of wild photos/videos, and priceless memories. Become a local in just 1 day., Come see why this tour is Next-Level.

tours.name: Doors Off Helicopter Adventure
tours.description:
As the third-largest and most populated island in Hawaii, Oahu offers several incredible sights. Home to Hawaii’s capital city, Honolulu, and historic—including Diamond Head and Pearl Harbor—the only way to truly appreciate it all is through a helicopter tour over Oahu.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

Your Hawaiian Doors Off helicopter tour begins with a beautiful view of Keehi Lagoon and continues over historic Honolulu Harbor, Aloha Tower, and the Natural Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific. While flying over these beautiful landmarks, you’ll also get an incredible birds-eye view of the Koolau mountains, Ala Moana Beach Park, and Waikiki Beach. Next on the tour are some of Oahu’s most vistas, including Kaawa Valley, Sacred Falls, the North
highlights: 50-minute Hawaiian Doors Off helicopter tour that immerses you in the natural beauty of Oahu
Soar over the island’s most picturesque locations—all narrated by our expert pilot/tour guides
Flying with the doors off the aircraft will give you a spectacular unobstructed view of the island’s best landmarks and attractions
Bring a light jacket. The flight can be chilly and windy.
Wear sunglasses to keep the wind out of your eyes.
Wear closed toed shoes. Loose “Slippers” (sandals) will be removed and stored during your flight to make sure they don’t fly out the door.
Arrive at our office 45 minutes before your scheduled flight time.
Guests must be able to step up 3 steps to board.

tours.name: Self|Guided Kayaking Discovery
tours.description:
Self-Guided Kayaking Discovery

The Self-Guided Tour is designed for the independent adventurer looking for new discoveries in Kailua’s unspoiled, pristine waters and beaches. This tour proves a great value for a full day activity in Hawaii!

Tour Details

Reef-protected Kailua Bay provides a safe environment for the beginner paddler and advanced paddler alike. A comprehensive video briefing, weather updates, and instructions given by our experienced staff prepare our guests for a unique day in Kailua Bay. Not far down the beach from Flat Island is a spot inhabited by the protected Green Sea Turtles. There are often several encounters on each trip. Green Sea Turtles are a threatened species, and seeing them is a very special experience. Snorkel gear is provided to explore the Kailua coral heads. Visit your choice of several offshore islands, sanctuaries and beaches and find solitude exploring at your own pace. Find a spot to eat lunch and take a swim or snorkel at your leisure. Afterwards there is time to head out for some fun in the surf. Boogie-boarding is a favorite at the North end of the beach where the shore break forms a perfect wave.

tours.name: Kailua Beach Experience
tours.description:
Kailua Beach Experience

Kailua Beach has been voted “The Best Beach in the United States!” Escape the crowds and take part in fun-filled activities. Kailua Beach Park is known for its fine white sand, pristine turqouise water, and natural beauty. This is the laid back tour where you can go snorkel, boogie board or just catch some rays at your leisure. Lunch and all equipment are included on this day of fun!

Other Details

Boogie boarding is a favorite at the North end of the beach where the shore break forms a perfect wave. Adults and kids love the boogie boarding option on this day at the beach. The East end of Kailua Bay features calm water and is the best location for snorkeling. Snorkel among sea turtles and other marine life. Experience the natural wonders of Hawaii and Kailua Bay. Mask and snorkel are provided for use on this tour.

Take a break around noon and make your way back for lunch. Rejuvenate and refresh yourself with our beach showers before heading back out to the beach to bask in the tropical sun! We supply all the equipment, so just come ready to have some fun! Be sure to bring your swimsuit and comfortable beach walking shoes, as best snorkel spots are up to a twenty-minute walk.

What's included
Free

Come explore Hawaii's beautiful ocean in search of Humpback Whales. Enjoy views of the iconic south side of Oahu and snorkel if you like as you join our crew on a private catamaran cruise in Waikiki.

Embark on a truly exclusive and intimate experience with a private whale watching cruise in Oahu. Glide through the pristine waters of the Pacific aboard your chartered 30 foot catamaran, where you and your group can enjoy uninterrupted views of humpback whales as they breach and play in their natural habitat. Come find them with us! Our knowledgeable crew will give you the best chance of finding these creatures.

With personalized attention from our knowledgeable guides, a private whale-watching cruise in Oahu offers the flexibility to tailor the itinerary to your preferences. Whether it’s capturing moments on camera or delving deeper into the fascinating behaviors of these magnificent creatures, our private tours ensure an enriching and encounter with Oahu’s awe-inspiring marine life. Optional snorkel time is also included and is always a fun and memorable part of any cruise!

Escape the crowds and revel in the tranquility of the ocean as you witness these gentle giants, creating cherished memories with your loved on

tours.name: Hidden Gems of Oahu with Waimea Botanical Garden
tours.priceLabel: Hidden Gems with Waimea Botanical Garden (Adult)
tours.description:
Summary

Explore Oahu on this all-day circle island with Byodo In and Turtle Spotting Tour, with stops at top scenic and cultural spots. Experience the tranquility of the Byodo-In Temple, a Japanese replica temple nestled in the lush Valley of the Temples. You'll enjoy mountain views, visit pristine beaches, and spot sea turtles along the North Shore. Midway through, enjoy a delicious lunch at a local eatery, enjoying authentic island flavors. This tour offers a perfect blend of sightseeing, Hawaiian culture, and nature, making it a memorable day of island discovery.

What's included

Guided Sightseeing Tour:
Enjoy a scenic drive with stops at notable Oahu landmarks.

Byodo In Temple Entry:
Ticket included. With lush gardens, koi ponds, and a tranquil Buddha statue, it offers visitors a peaceful escape and a chance to ring the bon-sho bell for good fortune.

Itinerary Highlights:
Visit Diamond Head, Halona Blowhole, and Makapu’u Point.

Air-Conditioned Vehicle:
Travel comfortably throughout the tour.

Hotel Pick-Up and Drop-Off:
From Waikiki hotels.

What's not included

Lunch:
Not included in the tour; cash or credit is required for food purchases.

Gratuities:
Tips for
highlights:
📍 Halona Blowhole
Watch as powerful waves force seawater through a natural lava tube, creating a dramatic, geyser-like spray—an unforgettable photo opportunity.

📍 Makapuʻu Point Lookout (Drive-by)
Enjoy scenic views of the windward coast and Rabbit Island as we cruise past this dramatic stretch of coastline.

☕️ Kona Coffee, Macadamia Nuts & Chocolates
Stop at a charming roadside shop to sample locally made treats under the shade of island trees.

📸 Chinaman’s Hat & Kualoa Valley
Snap unforgettable photos of these iconic landscapes, famously featured in movies like Jurassic Park.

📍 Nuʻuanu Pali Lookout
Soak in panoramic views from this historic cliffside, where King Kamehameha fought the decisive battle to unite the Hawaiian Islands.

🍽️ North Shore Lunch
Savor the island’s famous garlic shrimp (vegetarian options available) at a local eatery. Cash recommended.

🍍 Tropical Fruit Stand
Sample fresh island fruit like coconut, pineapple, or mango from a local vendor.

📍 Sunset Beach (Drive-by)
Pass by one of Hawaiʻi’s most beautiful beaches, home to world-famous winter waves and golden sands.

It’s the rare pairing of two awe-inspiring moments — sunset and whales — best experienced far from the crowds, with marine biologists who know this coastline and its wildlife intimately.

This isn’t a party cruise; it’s an expedition aboard our stable, shaded 34-ft power catamaran (capped at just ten guests — ask about private or larger group options).

Itinerary

Kaʻena Point = Whale Central
Adventure off the path to Oahu's most whale-rich area. This remote, rugged coastline is a biological hotspot where humpback whales gather during breeding season. Take a front-row seat to awe-inspiring behaviors like breaches, tail slaps, and vocalizations. Often we and the whales will encounter other curious wildlife as well.

Highlights

Itinerary
🌺 Circle Island Tour Overview

Your day begins with a comfortable, semi-private shuttle pickup from Waikīkī between 7:00 and 7:30 AM. A friendly local guide will accompany you, sharing stories, history, and aloha spirit to set the tone for an journey around Oʻahu.

📍 Diamond Head Lookout (Amelia Earhart Lookout)
Our first stop offers panoramic views of Oʻahu’s southeastern coastline. On clear days, you might even spot Maui in the distance. This historic site is where crowds once gathered to witness Amelia Earhart’s solo flight from Hawaiʻi to North America.

📍 Halona Blowhole
This natural lava tube sends ocean water shooting skyward like a Hawaiian geyser when the waves hit just right—perfect for dramatic photos!

📍 Makapuʻu Point Lookout (Drive-by)
Enjoy scenic views of rugged sea cliffs and Rabbit Island, named for the rabbits
highlights:
📍 Halona Blowhole
This natural lava tube sends ocean water shooting skyward like a Hawaiian geyser when the waves hit just right—perfect for dramatic photos!

📍 Makapuʻu Point Lookout (Drive-by)
Enjoy scenic views of rugged sea cliffs and Rabbit Island, named for the rabbits introduced there in the 1880s.

📍 Hawaiian Coffee & Macadamia Nut Tastings
Sample locally grown coffee, macadamia nuts, and chocolate under the shade of old banyan trees—a delicious mid-morning treat.

📍 Chinaman’s Hat & Kualoa Valley Lookout
Pause to admire the iconic Mokoliʻi (Chinaman’s Hat) and the dramatic Kualoa mountain range, backdrop to films like Jurassic Park.

🍽️ Lunch at a North Shore Local Restaurant
Taste the island’s famous garlic shrimp (vegetarian options available). Please bring cash for lunch.

🍍 Tropical Fruit Stand Stop
Enjoy fresh island fruits like coconut, pineapple, and mango from a local roadside stand.

📍 Sunset Beach (Drive-by)
Take in the beauty of one of the North Shore’s most famous surf beaches, known for its monster winter waves.

🐢 Hawaiian Green Sea Turtle Spotting
Visit Puaʻena Point or Haleʻiwa, where you may spot honu (Hawaiian sea turtles) resting on the beach.

tours.name: Huaka'i Waʻa Pe’a (Hawaiian Sailing Canoe)
tours.description:
Kailua, HI

3 hours • Hawaiian Sailing Canoe Voyage • Most popular! • Ages 3+

Hawaiian Sailing Canoe Tour
Duration

3-hour Hawaiian Sailing Canoe Adventure

About

Sail beautiful Kailua on a Waʻa Peʻa (Hawaiian Sailing Canoe); a cultural craft designed and used by the Hawaiians to navigate and sail the ocean. Join our watermen, learning about the history and cultural significance of the canoe and Kailua to the Hawaiian and Polynesian people, as we journey to our offshore islets. It's a Hawaiian experience unlike any other!

During the tour, explore the ecosystem as we move through the glistening, clear coral reefs of Kailua with honu (sea turtles) and other native species of fishes. Enjoy the views of the Ko’olau range surrounding us as our watermen tell the mo’olelo (stories) of various Ahupua’a (land divisions) that make up Kailua and the Ka Iwi coastline. View and learn of the indigenous seabirds, such as ‘Iwa (Great Frigate) and ‘Ua‘u kani (Wedge-tail Shearwater), that call the sanctuary island home.

• Participants required to arrive & check in with guide 15 minutes PRIOR to tour departure time
• Participants required to sign electronic liability waiver
• Paddling is required
• You WILL GET WET

Max allotted number of guests per canoe - 6. For parties larger than 6, you will be placed in two separate canoes.

tours.description:
Up to 20 people • 2 hours • Ages 18+ to book

A chance to experience Hawaiian wildlife
About

Snorkel with turtles and marine wildlife on the south shore of Oahu!
Enjoy amazing panoramic views of the Oahu coastline and Diamond Head as we depart Kewalo harbor just outside of Waikiki. Swim with turtles and wildlife at our favorite snorkel spot with our expert guides. They will point out the turtles and wildlife. Then enjoy fresh local fruit, snacks and drinks as we make our way back to the harbor. This trip is always a highlight for our guest's vacation to Hawaii..

Hawaii is well known for its tropical beaches and crystal-clear waters. In these waters, one of the most famous residents is dolphins. These majestic animals are a large part of Hawaiian culture. There are 8 species of dolphins in Hawaii. Spinning dolphins are the most commonly seen as they frequent the shores during daytime. It’s named for the way it has the ability to “spin” its body around as many as six times when it leaps out of the water.

Book your adventure today!

tours.name: Hilo After Dark 👻
tours.description:
Duration

1.5 Hours

TOUR OVERVIEW:
Hilo days might be warm, but when the sun goes down and there's a chill in the air, it's easy to imagine eerie happenings among the quiet beaches and rustling palms. Investigate sites of paranormal occurrences with a local guide, scoping out haunted hotels and historic sites as you hear tales of spooky sightings.

Begin your outing with a prayer of protection and a statement of intention, and listen as your guide provides a brief history of Hilo. Hear about supernatural activity in the islands as you begin your tour in the Queen Liliuokalani Gardens, where ghostly sightings have occurred in the past, and then make your way to Coconut Island, following the route of the legendary Night Marchers.

Pass by the massive, tangled trees that line Banyan Drive, planted long ago by visiting celebrities like Babe Ruth, and wind up near the site of an ancient Hawaiian graveyard. At each spine-tingling location along the way, pull out specialized paranormal activity detection equipment and see if you can detect any unusual spiritual presences. Your experience concludes with a cleansing white sage ritual before your guide sends you on your way.
​

Paddle the clear waters of Kailua as we journey to explore our offshore islets - private wildlife sanctuary islands. Come join us for an unique Hawaiian experience unlike any other in the world!

During the adventure, you will be given the opportunity to explore the ecosystem as we paddle through the glistening, clear coral reefs of Kailua with honu (sea turtles) and other native sea life. While on the islands enjoy the views of the Ko’olau range surrounding us as our watermen tell the mo’olelo (stories) of the rich history of the region. Explore and learn about the many native inhabitants that call the Mokuluas home.

On the ride back, you'll have the unique opportunity as we catch some waves on the canoe and surf Hawaiian style; an original favorite pastime of local Hawaiians

tours.name: Kona History Walk 🌺
tours.description:
Duration

1 Hour

About

Not everyone is interested in the paranormal and we respect that. That's why we also offer a non-paranormal history tour.

​Take a step back in time on a daytime history tour through Kona. Visit and experience some of Kailua-Kona's most important historic sites, including a Hawaiian Palace, the first Christian church in Hawaii, a King's temple, and more. This is a history tour and does not include ghost stories.

Meet your guide and set out to explore Kailua-Kona's early origins and the wonders of Hawaii's mysterious past. Learn about rulers like King Kamehameha, who united all the Hawaiian islands, and Queen Liliuokalani, the last monarch of the Kingdom of Hawaii. As you explore, discover how Kailua-Kona went from a small fishing village to Hawaii's first capital city.

​Along the way, visit an ancient Hawaiian temple as well as the Hulihee Palace, the one-time vacation home of Hawaiian royalty. Step inside Mokuaikawa Church, the first Christian church in Hawaii, and see the Hale Halawaio Holualoa church, which is built of lava rock and coral. Stop by the 1928 Kona Inn with its famous red roofs, and pick up pointers on other great areas to explore from your guide.

8 Hours • All Ages Welcome!

Something for the history buff in everyone
Duration

8 Hours

About

Spend your morning at Pearl Harbor and experience all the WWII history that you can fit into one day. This semi-private tour begins with a Minivan pick-up at your hotel in Waikiki (or a hotel close by) and includes the following fascinating glimpses into history:

USS Arizona
The Arizona was sunk as part of the attack on Pearl Harbor by the Imperial Japanese Navy on December 7th, 1941. This tour includes tickets for the National Park Service movie and boat ride out to the Memorial, a graceful structure that spans the sunken battleship. You will also have time to visit the two National Park Service exhibit galleries, “Road to War” and “Attack”.

USS Bowfin Submarine Museum & Park
The USS Bowfin Submarine is moored proudly near the Arizona Memorial, ready to welcome visitors to the fabled era of WW II submarines and their crews. This is a place filled with tales of men who served under extreme conditions with strength, bravery and honor. Whether inspired by the sheer adventure of the journey or the amazing heroism of the crew, visitors come away from the USS Bowfin Submarine Museum & Park enriched and inspired by the impressive role the US submariners played in winning the War in the Pacific.

Battleship Missouri Memorial

tours.description:
Duration

5 Hours

Diamond Head Crater & Waterfall Hike Combo Package

We start with a two-hour walk through the forest to the classic Hawaiian forty-meter waterfall. The total length (round trip) Route easy initial category 2,5 km. Well-groomed trail goes through the rainforest along the creek through a grove of tall bamboo, on the road - aerial roots Banyan Tree, eucalyptus trees, entwined with drooping to the ground vines huge trees Samaan, guava, various species of palm trees, Hawaiian nut kukui, African tulip, red and white ginger wild hibiscus, mountain apple, and many other species of native and imported plants. At the beginning of the trail - filming location of the famous television series "Lost." After the walk - a treat local donuts in the bakery of the city's most popular Honolulu.

Next we visit the city's famous landmark the rising tide on the south wall of the crater. Easy trail with a gradual rise leads to the highest point of the crater - a former artillery command post. The award, after overcoming a 99 stair steps at the end of mashruta, beautiful panoramic views of Waikiki and Honolulu. After the walk - the restoration of the lost calories local donuts in the bakery of the city's most popular Honolulu.

tours.description:
Duration

1 Day

Day trip to the Island of Hawaii

The most popular version of the "Holo-Holo" (trip) to the other islands

Island of Hawaii … the most active volcano of the world's rainiest city USA, the best coffee in the world … The most "Hawaiian" and exotic island filled with "mana" (Hawaiian spirit).

The main attraction of the island - an active volcano. Have you ever come on top of an erupting volcano? - 40-minute flight takes you to Hilo - the island's capital. Travel along Hilo Bay, banyan alley a picturesque Queen Liliuokalani park - to the historical center.

Not far from there is the virgin, primeval beauty of the tropical forest, a 130-meter waterfall, sugar cane, orchid and macadamia nut plantations.

You will visit the National Park, Kilauea volcano, see it steaming caldera, eruptive and pit craters, steam and gas vents, pass through a lava tube, fern-tree forest , visit the volcanology museum, lava fields, you might also see the eruption of lava *.

Additionally, you will visit the unique black sand beach of lava. The beach is favorite with large sea turtles - you can join them on the beach and in the water.

Viewing of molten lava is not guaranteed - reliably see red molten lava is only possible with the help of helicopters or boats.

Cancellations

tours.name: Diamond Head Bike to Hike
tours.description:
Challenge yourself with adventure!

We meet early at 7:00 am to avoid crowds and the heat on the crater trial. After your bike fitting and safety instruction, we roll onto Kapiolani Park to discover its history then we head down to the WW1 Natatorium Memorial to see where famed Duke Kahanamoku and others trained for the Olympics. You’ll get to visit a secluded green sand beach at the base of Diamond Head; see the Disney house and roll past other homes from the marvels of wealth. We then pedal up 150 feet to the Diamond Head Light House Lookout. From this advantageous view, you can see the surfers enjoying the placid waters of Hawaii.

While getting photos with the Amelia Earhart memorial, we'll observe Doris Duke’s Shangri-La museum located in the wealthy Black Point neighborhood. After a short 100' elevation gain, we arrive near the Hawaii FIVE-O / NCIS Hawaii studios where they film ongoing TV series. Next, we head into Diamond Head Crater's 150' climb and park our bikes for a 45-minute to 1-hour hike, a 300' climb filled with lots of Hawaiian and WWI history. Along the way, you’ll experience incredible views of Oahu’s south and east-facing shores. After the hike and photos, we descend to a healthy local inclusive lunch. Sunscreen, water, sports drinks, and snacks are provided.

tours.name: Nani Wailele Beautiful Waterfall  Navigation Guided Tour
tours.description:
Automatic Transmission 
Must be 21 years old to drive 
Max 2 Passengers  

From Kona to Hilo, your journey progresses from sea level to an elevation of 6,632 feet, accelerating across Saddle Road (HWY 200) taking in the views between Mauna Loa & Mauna Kea. The Nani Wailele Tour focuses on the Big Island’s most magnificently beautiful waterfalls.
  
Begin with a trek to the east side of the island on Saddle Road. On the east side of the island, you will stop first at Rainbow Falls. Next head north of Hilo on Highway 19, the Belt Road on the Hamakua Coast can provide some amazing and spontaneous falling waterfalls in the jungle viewable from the road. The massive 400-foot-tall Akaka Falls is the behemoth everyone wants to see, however, do not miss out on other gorgeous ones such as Pe’epe’e Falls, or Onomea Falls. Before heading home enjoy some fresh and delicious Malasadas at World Famous Tex’s Drive-In or take them to Waipio Valley Lookout. Remember traveling from the Leeward to the Wayward side of the island can mean frequent weather changes, so it is a great idea to bring a jacket or hoodie.  

Our fully integrated navigation system has this tour pre-programmed to let you see the best! No need to rush, you have a full 8 hours to experience all of the island’s aloha on this tour.

Wrapping around the southern tip of the island you will be cruising in the shadows of Mauna Loa, the Earth’s largest active volcano. Stop off for a plunge at Papakōlea Green Sand Beach and/or Punaluʻu Black Sand Beach before heading into the 323,000 acres of Volcanoes National Park, home to Kīlauea, one of the most active volcanoes in the world. Aside from good fishing we have been seeing dolphins regularly and Humpback whales every winter as this their mating season here in Hawaii runs from December up until the beginning of May. We invite you to be a part of our “ ohana” or family and share our love for the ocean. Hope to see you soon.

tours.description:
About

Embark on an ocean adventure at Maunalua Bay, with Hawaii Kai’s only Whale Watching Cruise! This excursion provides you with a unique and up-close view to witness the annual return of Alaska’s humpback whales as they give birth in the warm tropical waters off Oahu’s coast from December through April. Marvel at these majestic animals with an intimate and uncrowded exploration in the Humpback Whale National Marine Sanctuary on the East Coast of Waikiki, where you will experience views of Diamond Head and Koko Head.

During this cruise, you will be scouting for marine life assisting captain and crew, while learning all about the behaviors, life cycles and habitats of these enchanting animals and other marine life in addition to Oahu’s spectacular sites! Feel free to upload any photos to happywhale.com where each whale can be tracked and identified!

• A healthy snack and water will be provided, and feel free to bring your favorite non-Alcoholic beverages.

Cruise along the scenic Waikiki coastline with front-row views of Diamond Head Crater and the Hawaiian sunset lighting up the sky. But this isn’t your average sightseeing cruise — this is a high-energy, open-air party built for fun-loving adventurers.

Turn up the vibe with live DJ music spinning tropical beats, club favorites, and party anthems while you move between dancing, snapping sunset selfies, or jumping into the ocean.

And yes — it’s not just a cruise. It’s a floating trampoline party. Our massive water trampoline turns the ocean into your playground. Bounce, flip, splash, or just laugh with friends — there’s no better way to make memories in Hawaii.

Bring your own drinks with our BYOB-friendly policy, and for guests 21+, enjoy two complimentary Mai Tai cocktails on us. Indoor and shaded outdoor seating available for when you need a break from the dance floor.

tours.name: Waikiki Sunset Boat Cruise BYOB
tours.description:
Free cancellation
Instant confirmation
The perfect end to a day in Hawaii!
About

Join us for one of Hawaii's amazing sunsets! We adventure out of Kewalo Harbor pre-sunset with great music and exceptional snack and beverage service from our crew. Once out of the harbor we head up towards world famous Diamond Head crater while looking for dolphins and giant green sea turtles that frequent the coast. Enjoy the views of the lush green valleys of Oahu's mountain ranges and valleys, the sandy beaches and cityscape of Waikiki and the endless horizon of the Pacific Ocean as the sun begins to set. The reflection of the final rays of light shimmering over the water is pure magic. This is a perspective of Oahu you can only see by boat.

We are a BYOB charter with on board ice, large ice chests and refrigeration for all of your favorite beverages and additional snacks. We do provide local juices, refreshments and local chips during the charter.

Want a photo?! Our crew is more than happy to capture it for you with your camera or phone so don't be shy.

tours.name: Dolphin Dreaming
tours.description:
Dolphin watching and coral reef snorkeling on Kona's crystal clear coastline.

What's included

Snorkel gear

Snacks & beverages

Itinerary

We cruise from the Keauhou Harbor out into crystal clear blue waters.

While underway, the captain will be searching for dolphins close to shore, and your crew will provide an educational briefing on Kona's sealife.

We often find dolphins close to shore in small family groups, or pods, of 5-30 individuals. These small family pods are resting and socializing in shallow, clear water along the coast. They prefer protected bay-like areas, which provide a calm environment for the dolphin to sleep periodically throughout the day.

In addition to dolphin watching, this tour includes snorkeling in the best snorkel bays on the Big Island. Your Captain will lead you to one or more locations to swim amongst the coral reefs, abundant schools of fish, and wildlife that includes manta rays, Hawaiian spinner dolphins, spotted dolphins, and a wide variety of sea life on Kona's magical coastline.

This is where aloha meets adventure!
About

Experience the Magic of the Humpback Sanctuary

Step aboard our intimate and very comfortable 6-passenger vessel for an whale-watching adventure where everyone has a great seat for viewing (especially photographers). We launch directly within the heart of the humpback sanctuary, where encounters with mother-and-calf pairs, energetic competition pods (hello, breaching!), and even singing whales are part of the experience. Yes—we have a hydrophone on board so you can listen in!

Guided by Captain Kelsey, Captain Steve (from Alaska), or Captain Gerald (fantastic photographer) and our knowledgeable crew, you’ll enjoy 1 hour and 45 minutes of captivating storytelling, fascinating cetacean insights, and rich Big Island history. Photographers love this trip—Captains are attentive to lighting and positioning, helping you capture that perfect shot.

tours.name: Whale Watching Cruise
tours.description:
Watch whales swim, play, feed and breach, in their natural environment. This excursion is truly a life altering experience. This Prince Kuhio Cruise is truly awe-inspiring. Our large open decks offer an exceptional platform for viewing.

What's included

Welcoming and Professional Service

Views of Waikiki shoreline and Diamond Head

Indoor and Outdoor Seating Options

Laid Back and Relaxed Atmosphere

Full Cash or Credit Tiki Bar Available

All cruises are currently BYOB

Itinerary

One of the most popular marine activities in Hawaii is watching the pods of great whales, especially humpback whales, wintering in the warm Hawaiian waters between mid-December and March. Watching the whales swim, play, feed and breach, in their natural environment, is truly awe-inspiring. As a bonus, other marine life such as dolphins and sea turtles also tend to make an appearance. The Prince Kuhio offers an exceptional platform for this experience by providing a large, stable upper deck for viewing as well as on-board, freshly prepared food and drink services.

tours.name: Afternoon Kealakekua Snorkel and Sail
tours.description:
Sail “Kona Style” and experience the pristine waters of the Kona Coast!
Times

Departure: 12:30pm
Return: 4:00pm
Please check-in 30 minutes prior to your scheduled departure time

About

Sail “Kona Style” and experience the pristine waters of the Kona Coast as we make our way to Kealakekua Bay, which is home to the Captain Cook Monument and a marine sanctuary filled with with tropical i’a (fish) and beautiful coral structures. Venture the netted trampolines suspended over the ocean or relax in the shaded open air cabin and enjoy the soothing tropical breezes, while keeping watch for nai’a (dolphins), honu (turtles), hahalua (manta rays) and kohola (whales-seasonal).

Once we arrive at our snorkel destination, hear about Captain Cook's travel to Hawai'i before jumping in to snorkel in the marine sanctuary. After snorkeling, join us back on the boat for lunch, with fresh deli sandwiches, pasta salad, chips and ice cold beverages. All non-alcoholic beverages are complimentary and guests may purchase beer, wine or cocktails from our full bar. After lunch, we make our way back to Kona, stopping along the way to view some of the unique landmarks along the Kona coast. All snorkel gear (with instruction) and swim noodles are also included.

tours.name: Tour a hidden Mango Coconut Orchard & Taste the land
tours.description:
Come visit a working food forest on Maui! This is a 4 acre coconut + mango orchard at the base of the West Maui Mountains at its back and the Pacific Ocean at its front.

Sitting in a beautiful setting across from the ocean — taste fresh picked fruits, like mangos, coconuts, and more - picked right off the trees in front of you!

Duration

35 minutes

Learn the many uses of the coconut plant - the tree of life. We have over 300 trees on site consisting of many varieties, along with incredible citrus, starfruit, and other fruits, vegetables, and plants that make this food forest a Maui gem.

This 35 minute tour shows you how we are regenerating this 20-year-old orchard that was left defunct for almost a decade! We have been cleaning it up and using regenerative practices to restore it while diversifying the crops with a unique model of agriculture that harvests several layers of crops from under the trees as well as what’s on them, mangos and coconuts.

A truly working food forest that we do not bring in fertilizers — we create all of our fertilizer on site with regenerative farming practices.

Experience an abundance of some of the tastiest and most nutrient dense food in the world!

5 minutes from Lahaina

マノア・チョコレート＆ワイン・バーのチョコレート・ソムリエ・チームと一緒に毎週開催される日本語ツアーに参加しませんか？ツアーはカカオ豆の焙煎室から始まり、カカオの果実ジュース(酵素ドリンク)を味わい、ハワイや世界中のカカオを試食し、焙煎されたカカオがどのようにしてチョコレートになるのかを学びます。

楽しみはそれだけではありません。テイスティング・ルームに戻り、当店の主要なチョコレート等のコレクションをすべて試食していただきます。お腹がいっぱいになっただけでなく、カカオという素晴らしいスーパーフードをより深く知り、これから成長するクラフトチョコレート・ムーブメントに、ハワイのカカオとKokoleka （ハワイ語でチョコレート）産業にアロハを感じていただけることでしょう。

2010年以来、オアフ島のカイルアで受賞歴のあるチョコレートを作り続けています。ハワイ諸島全域と世界中からカカオを調達し、それぞれの豆の良さを最大限に引き出し、農家にとってもお客様にとってもより倫理的なカカオ産業に貢献することを目標としています。

tours.name: Kealakekua Bay OE1
tours.description:
Duration

Approx. 4 hr. Encounter (8:30am-12:30pm)

About

Ocean Encounters
Kealakekua Bay
Strap on your snorkel gear and get ready to jump into the warm waters for the swim of a lifetime. Departing from Honokohau Harbor, join us for this 4 hour morning reef snorkel while we motor down the beautiful Kona Coast to Kealakekua Bay, one of Hawaii’s most renowned marine sanctuaries. Kealakekua Bay is a protected bay, widely regarded as some of the best snorkeling in Hawaii!! Keep your eyes open for spinner dolphins known to use this famous bay as their resting grounds. This Bay is home to the historical Captain Cook Monument and known for its vibrant coral reefs and abundant sea life with 100's of species of tropical fish.

Included in your experience are snorkel gear, swimming noodles, assorted dry snacks and chilled bottled water. To fully enjoy your adventure, bring a towel, reef safe sunblock, dry clothes, and a camera. You must know how to swim to participate..

Location may change due to weather and sea conditions.

Please remember to use your “Reef Safe Sun
Block”, it is a Hawaii State Law.

PLEASE NOTE OUR OFFICE HOURS ARE 9AM TIL 6PM Hawaii Standard Time. SHOULD YOU NEED TO CONTACT US FOR ANY REASON PLEASE DO SO DURING OFFICE HOURS.

tours.name: Secrets Of Hamakua HILO (SHIP)
tours.description:
Explore the famed Hamakua Coast, home to magnificent country reminiscent of “old Hawaii”.
Duration

7.5 Hours

About

Sparsely populated Hamakua is studded with waterfalls, valleys, and eccentric towns. Traveling north, first stop at Tex Drive-In, famous for made-to- order malasadas. These fried Portuguese sweet treats were originally brought to Hawaii by immigrants who worked in the cattle industry and have been a local favorite ever since. Watch the treats being made through the window and snag a fresh one with a cup of coffee. The Valley of the Kings, Waipio Valley is a place of impossibly steep cliffs carved by plunging waterfalls cascading more than a thousand feet to the valley floor below. Waipio Valley is still home to taro farmers as it has been for a thousand years. Look closely from the overlook and glimpses of the wild horses that roam the valley floor might be possible. Turning off the highway we descend into Laupahoehoe Point. Laupahoehoe village was located here until the destruction left behind the 1946 tsunami forced the town to move to higher ground. tours.name: Private Helicopter Landing
tours.description:
As the third-largest and most populated island in Hawaii, Oahu offers several incredible sights. Home to Hawaii’s capital city, Honolulu, and historic—including Diamond Head and Pearl Harbor—the only way to truly appreciate it all is through a helicopter tour over Oahu.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

For a truly special experience, Magnum Helicopters will give you, not only our famous Doors Off Adventure, but we'll also take you to a private landing spot overlooking the famous Waimea Bay. Take pictures, sip some champagne (our treat) and just relax and enjoy the view over Waimea Bay, where big-wave surfers come every year in search of the ultimate thrill. A great place to pop the question to that special someone, away from the hustle & bustle of Waikiki.

• Total Duration: Approx. 1-1/2 hours
• 1–4 Guests*
• *Some weight limitations may apply.

What's included
50-minute Hawaiian Doors Off helicopter tour that immerses you in the natural beauty of Oahu
Soar over the island’s most picturesque locations—all narrated by our expert pilot/tour guides
Flying with the doors off the aircraft will give you a spectacular unobstructed view of the island’s best landmarks and attractions
Additional

Arrive at our office 45 minutes before your scheduled flight time.

tours.name: Custom Hourly
tours.description:
A private tour around the island of Oahu offers a personalized and flexible way to explore the island's diverse landscapes, rich history, and vibrant culture. Unlike large bus tours, a private tour allows you to customize your itinerary, linger at places you love, and travel at your own pace with a dedicated guide.

Here's what you can expect from a typical private tour around Oahu

North Shore: Experience the world-famous surfing mecca, visiting legendary surf spots like Banzai Pipeline and Waimea Bay. You can also enjoy a leisurely stroll through the charming town of Haleiwa.

East Coast (Windward Side): Marvel at the dramatic Koolau Mountains, and stop at beautiful beaches like Lanikai and Kailua, often considered among the world's best.

South Shore: Start your journey with iconic views of Diamond Head, and pass by pristine beaches like Hanauma Bay and Sandy Beach.

Cultural and Historical Sites:

Dole Plantation: Learn about the history of pineapple in Hawaii and enjoy a famous Dole Whip.

Byodo-In Temple: A replica of a Japanese temple, offering a peaceful and beautiful setting.

Pali Lookout: Take in panoramic views of the windward side of the island from this historic site, where King Kamehameha I fought a decisive battle.

Local Experiences:

Food: Your guide can take you to local food trucks and eateries, allowing you to sample Hawaiian delicac

tours.name: SUP Intro Sunset Tour
tours.description:
Ease your way into the sport by trying out a SUP—significantly easier than surfing but more physically intensive than kayaking, SUP makes exercise fun again.

Because Surf N Sea is right on the beach, you can rent one of our SUP boards and walk a few feet directly into the ocean! SUP rentals include a SUP board and paddle. We carry a large inventory of boards 9-12 ft

Summers provide the perfect SUP conditions with calm waters behind Surf N Sea. Our beach boys will point out boundaries to keep you safe. The Anahulu Stream, where you can often spot turtles hanging out is a great paddle for beginners or when ocean and wind conditions are not optimal. When the waves are big in the winter on the North Shore, you can even try your hand at SUP surfing.

Come down and explore.

tours.description:
Inclusions

About
Experience Oahu's ultimate helicopter tour in VIP luxury. Depart Honolulu airport and begin your helicopter adventure by flying over Waikiki's shoreline, where the modern metropolis of Honolulu meets the white sands of Waikiki's iconic beaches. Your tour will continue down the leeward coast to Diamond Head, Koko Head and the historic Makapu'u Point Lighthouse. Continuing north up the windward coast, you will pass over Kailua Beach, the famous landmark Chinaman's Hat and the pristine reef and waters of Kaneohe Bay. The tour will continue north to Jurassic Valley and Sacred Falls. views of Oahu's famous North Shore will follow. Views of Banzai Pipeline and Waimea Bay, home of Oahu's legendary monster waves, are spectacular. Your tour will close with a slow flyover of Pearl Harbor and the USS Arizona. Experience all of Oahu’s major sites in 60 minutes of VIP Luxury.

tours.description:
About

Here are three sample private tour itineraries:

Sample Itinerary 1: Waimea Falls Hiking
Begin your day with ease as we pick you up from your hotel at 7:30 AM. At 9:00 AM, we'll delve into the wonders of Waima Valley, embarking on an enriching hike that leads to the captivating Waimea Falls. By 11:30 AM, we'll find ourselves at the tranquil Sunset Beach, a perfect spot to unwind.

At 12:30 PM, we'll arrive at Haleiwa Town, a charming oasis where you can explore unique shops and enjoy local cuisine. As the day unfolds, you'll immerse yourself in North Shore culture and scenery. At 3:30 PM, we'll ensure a comfortable return to your Waikiki hotel, leaving you with cherished memories of your North Shore adventure.

Sample Itinerary 2: Haleiwa Water Activities
Our day begins with a hotel pick-up at 7:30 AM, setting the stage for an action-packed adventure. At 9:00 AM, we'll arrive at Haleiwa Beach, where you can choose from a range of exciting activities, including kayaking, surfing lessons, and biking, ensuring there's something for everyone.

By 12:30 PM, we'll explore Haleiwa Town, a picturesque North Shore hub filled with charm and culinary delights. The afternoon is yours to make the most of this vibrant community. Finally, at 3:30 PM, we'll provide a comfortable return to your Waikiki hotel, allowing you to relax and relish the memories of your water-filled day.

tours.name: Guided Snorkeling Tour
tours.description:
Snorkeling with Turtles
About

We head out of Waianae Boat Harbor exploring the West Oahu coast in search of the, (Nai’a), Spinner Dolphins swimming the shallow waters after their morning hunt. While on the search, learn the natural history of Hawaii and the marine life of the Pacific from our incredible experienced and certified crew.

After the short cruise, we moor the boat at Makaha Caverns. One of Oahu famous swimming with turtles sites. The underwater lava tubes are almost a sure bet for viewing the green sea turtle in its natural environment.

All equipment for snorkeling, including flotation vests, are included in the tour, and for non swimmers we also have a large rescue float for your comfort in the water.

Expect wonderful colors, plentiful fish, and snorkeling with turtles. The western reefs offer a topography very unique to Oahu making it some of Hawaii's best snorkeling sites. These reefs are home to Octopus, butterfly fish, eels, Eagle rays, and other beautiful tropical fish. We might even get a visit from the resident spinner dolphins.

Coconut Island (Moku Ola) Drive-Thru – A peaceful island rich with Hawaiian legend.
